name: DotsiderSizeCheck
description: Enforce NativeAOT size budgets and publish JSON and Markdown reports.
helpMarkDown: Runs Dotsider against an application published with NativeAOT size sidecars. Publish the current application and retrieve any baseline in earlier pipeline steps.
author: willibrandon

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: Target
inputs.helpMarkDown: NativeAOT binary or .mstat report to check.

inputs.name: budgets
inputs.label: Budgets
inputs.helpMarkDown: Size budget expressions, one per line.

inputs.name: top
inputs.label: Top contributors
inputs.helpMarkDown: Number of contributors to include per report section.

inputs.name: why
inputs.label: Dependency chains
inputs.helpMarkDown: Include dependency chains from the target DGML sidecar.

inputs.name: dotsiderVersion
inputs.label: Dotsider version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Exact released Dotsider version, or latest.

inputs.name: dotsiderPath
inputs.label: Dotsider executable
inputs.helpMarkDown: Existing Dotsider executable. Bypasses download and checksum verification.

inputs.name: reportDirectory
inputs.label: Report directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory for JSON and Markdown reports.

inputs.name: publishSummary
inputs.label: Publish summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish the Markdown report as the pipeline summary.

inputs.name: publishReports
inputs.label: Publish reports
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish JSON and Markdown reports as a build artifact.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build artifact name for the reports.

outputVariables.name: jsonReportPath
outputVariables.description: Absolute path to the JSON report.

outputVariables.name: markdownReportPath
outputVariables.description: Absolute path to the Markdown report.

outputVariables.name: baselineTotal
outputVariables.description: Baseline total in bytes when supplied.
